snippet.title: The Expedition Gameplay Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
The Expedition is an action horror game in which you go on an 'Expedition'; little do you know, it will turn into your worst nightmare.

Coming to Steam Q2 2025 (April 1-June 30)

Music:
LaymGlitched - The Expedition (Unreleased Album)
